| Overview of the meta-model - SAP Reference Architecture: |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
| The Business/Solution Data Objects (short "BDO" / "SDO") are new content entities in the SAP Reference Architecture. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  | - Business Data Object (BDO) defines information objects or entities which are relevant for business. BDOs are used as inputs or outputs of Business Activities and Business Processes and support Business Capabilities. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
|  | - Solution Data Object (SDO) is a Solution Component-specific realization of a BDO, parts of a BDO or multiple BDOs. |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |  |
